newsitem.title: USA: China Resources in potential investment.
newsitem.headline: China Resources in potential investment.

text.p: China Resources Development Inc said Friday it was in the final stages of a comprehensive due diligence review of a potential strategic investment.
It did not specify what the investment is.
It also said it will not proceed with its previously announced letter of intent to form a wood processing joint venture with Sanya Timber Factory, which is based in Hainan, China.
It said the factory's profitability and future prospects did not meet its criteria for a net profit contribution.
It said the strategic investment, if consummated, would be accretive to future earnings.
The company today reported earnings per share for the second quarter of $0.13, compared to $0.58 for the same period a year ago.
The company said it had significantly lower margin contributions from the trading of agricultural products in the quarter compared to a year earlier.
